title: 116. We need a Data Processing Agreement, where is the EUSurvey DPA?
intent: This article explains an EUSurvey rule or privacy/data protection point related to: We need a Data Processing Agreement, where is the EUSurvey DPA.
short_answer: The EUSurvey Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available for all entities that are considered as Data Controller while we are processing your data through the EUSurvey platform. EUSurvey DPA is available here (/eusurvey/home/dpa).
procedure: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us (/eusurvey/home/support?dataprotection=1).
